messages:
graystoke-dev: Hey team, we started seeing p99 spikes on /v1/embeddings for tenant graystoke around 03:00 UTC yesterday. Baseline p50/p95 OK, but p99 jumps to ~4.5s. Any ideas?
marie (support): Sorry for the trouble — can you paste a sample request + tenant id? Are you on dedicated or hosted plan?
graystoke-dev: Tenant: graystoke-prod. Hosted API. Sample request: `POST /v1/embeddings` body size ~700 tokens, model `open-embedding-4`. Happens intermittently every ~20-40 minutes. Here's a trace link: https://redwood-traces/trace/abc123 (shows tail queueing)
leon (eng-sre): looking. Can you confirm whether these requests hit the same region and whether you're using batching?
graystoke-dev: All requests eu-west1, no manual batching client-side. Single request per user action.
leon (eng-sre): I pulled host-level logs for eu-west1 around those timestamps. Seeing long queue time on a small subset of requests landing on node g-euw-17. Queue depth spikes correlate with another tenant `zephyr-ads` on the same shard. Suspect noisy neighbor causing per-shard queueing.
anika (customer-success): We should offer a quick mitigation: temporary allowlist/reservation for graystoke or route to different shard. Customer prefers minimal change.
marie (support): Quick ask to prod infra: can we add graystoke-prod to an ephemeral allowlist so their requests skip best-effort shared-queue policies for 24h? @deploy-bot can you surface the reservation steps? :pray:
deploy-bot: To request ephemeral reservation, run internal CLI: 
````bash
redwood infra reserve --tenant graystoke-prod --region eu-west1 --duration 24h --priority high
````
(creates reservation ticket infra-RES-8291)
leon (eng-sre): Manual note: this will route traffic away from the shared low-priority queue to a reserved lane, reducing queuing. Also enabling a temporary per-tenant concurrency cap of 8 may help.
marie (support): Graystoke — do you want us to trigger the reservation now? We'll monitor p99 and rollback after 24h.
graystoke-dev: Please do it. We'll also enable client-side retry with jitter for 503s.
leon (eng-sre): Reservation created: infra-RES-8291. I added tenant to allowlist and set concurrency cap to 8. Monitoring: I see immediate drop in queue_time in prometheus for tenant graystoke-prod. Will keep an eye.
anika (customer-success): Also recommended: consider pinning to a model variant with lower memory pressure (open-embedding-4-quant) if cost/quality acceptable — reduces kernel stalls.
graystoke-dev: Noted. Can you share the short repro we used so we can simulate?
marie (support): Repro snippet we ran internally: 
````json
{
  "model": "open-embedding-4",
  "input": "<~700 token document>",
  "tenant_id": "graystoke-prod"
}
````
Send that 30x in parallel to reproduce queue buildup.
leon (eng-sre): Follow-up: we'll open a follow-up ticket to evaluate whether zephyr-ads should be moved off the shared shard (they are high-burst). Also adding telemetry to detect similar cross-tenant queue correlations.
marie (support): Graystoke — p99 dropped from ~4.5s to ~0.9s after reservation. We'll keep reservation for 24h and then reassess. Anything else you need?
graystoke-dev: That's great, thanks. Can you send the reservation ticket link and the temporary SLA notes?
anika (customer-success): Ticket infra-RES-8291 (https://redwood-infra/tickets/8291). Temporary SLA: we committed to investigating for 24h and will propose options (dedicated capacity / longer reservation / tenant isolation) in follow-up.
leon (eng-sre): One more: add this to the backlog — automated tenant allowlist flow for high p99 alerts (so support can self-serve). Filed: ENG-PLAT-1420.
marie (support): Closing loop here. If p99 rises again after rollback, reopen thread and we'll escalate to Dedicated onboarding. :+1:
